Author: ladykwrote

Rating: ExplicitLanguage: EnglishWords: 13,132Chapters: 4/6Kudos: 26

Summary: There was no preparing Clark for the loss of his father. Just as there had been no preparing for falling in love with Bruce Wayne. As Clark and Martha struggle with the loss, Bruce throws his money at the pain, which only does so much. But there are things that money can never repair or buy. or “I’m perfectly capable of taking care of my own family, Bruce. You're overstepping here-” Bruce was unflinching as he flicked his steely gaze upwards at him, “I thought you liked that I was a man of action. So, this is me actively saving your family farm from sinking into crippling debt.” Clark clenched again, “I’d have figured something out-” “On what, Clark, your paper route salary?” Bruce’s voice was unwavering; it lacked any emotion at all, which only served to burn Clark even hotter. He felt himself beginning to see red and tried to take calming breaths so he wouldn't be tempted to send a laser beam straight through Bruce Wayne's stupid face.

entry.title: Somethin’ Stupid
entry.summary:
Author: c1nnabon

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 17,108Chapters: 5/?Kudos: 51

Summary: "Clark, where are you?! I know you're in there somewhere!" The scream cuts through the silence of the wreckage, raw and fractured. Superman's eyes are clouded in cold detachment. He looks down with blazing indifference, pinning the vigilante with a force effortless for a god like Kal-El, but fatal for a man like Bruce. With his cowl shattered and air leaving his lungs, Bruce surrenders. He looks into the eyes of the man he trusted most, searching for even a flicker of the humanity Clark fought so hard for… only to find them empty. Vision blurring into nothingness, he forces his final words past his bleeding lips. "I really loved you, Clark. I still do. I believed in the world you promised us. You made me hope for a better future." Clark's thumb rests over Bruce's pulse point, sneering at the erratic rhythm of his heart. The heartbeat he once vowed to never forget rapidly slows, yet the hypnotised Kryptonian feels no pity. Gathering the last of his might, Bruce glares through fading consciousness, his voice dropping to a furious, desperate rasp. "Listen to my- heartbeat… you idiot. Just fucking listen to me." That was all Bruce could cough out before the line went slack.
